024/**
025 * Verifiable code examples for StreamConverter documentation.
026 *
027 * <p>This class contains actual, compilable, and runnable code examples that are referenced from
028 * documentation. Each example is marked with START/END comments for potential extraction into
029 * documentation.
030 *
031 * <p>All examples in this file are tested to ensure they compile and execute correctly.
032 */
033public class BasicUsageExamples {
034
035  // [START csv-navigate-basic]
036  /** CSV navigation pipeline example - applies transformation and processes. */
037  public void csvNavigateBasic() throws Exception {
038    // Sample CSV data
039    String csvData = "id,productName,price\n" + "1,Apple,100\n" + "2,Banana,50\n";
040    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
041    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
042
043    // Create pipeline: navigate CSV + process
044    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
045      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("productName"), new PassThroughRule()),
046      new SampleStreamCommand("csv-processor")
047    };
048
049    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
050    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
051
052    // Verify execution
053    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
054    if (!success) {
055      throw new RuntimeException("CSV navigation failed");
056    }
057  }
058
059  // [END csv-navigate-basic]
060

179  // [START pipeline-simple]
180  /** Simple pipeline example - chaining multiple commands. */
181  public void simplePipeline() throws Exception {
182    String csvData = "id,name,price\n1,Apple,100\n";
183    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes("Shift_JIS"));
184    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
185
186    // CSV → Character conversion → Output
187    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
188      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
189      new CharacterConvertCommand("Shift_JIS", "UTF-8")
190    };
191
192    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
193    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
194
195    boolean success = results.stream().allMatch(CommandResult::isSuccess);
196    if (!success) {
197      throw new RuntimeException("Pipeline execution failed");
198    }
199  }
200
201  // [END pipeline-simple]
202
203  // [START error-handling-basic]
204  /** Error handling pipeline example using CommandResult. */
205  public void errorHandlingBasic() throws Exception {
206    String csvData = "id,name\n1,Apple\n";
207    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
208    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
209
210    // Create pipeline for error handling demonstration
211    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
212      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
213      new SampleStreamCommand("error-handler")
214    };
215
216    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
217    List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
218
219    // Check results
220    for (CommandResult result : results) {
221      if (!result.isSuccess()) {
222        System.err.println("Command failed: " + result.getCommandName());
223        System.err.println("Error: " + result.getErrorMessage());
224      } else {
225        System.out.println(
226            "Success: "
227                + result.getCommandName()
228                + " (duration: "
229                + result.getExecutionTimeMillis()
230                + "ms)");
231      }
232    }
233  }
234  // [END error-handling-basic]
235}
